listing.name: Azur Lane Vanilla Portrait Replacer
listing.summary: Replaces nearly all vanilla portraits with Azur Lane-style designs and adds a large collection of extra portraits for various factions.
listing.aiSummary: Replaces nearly all vanilla portraits with Azur Lane-style designs and adds a large collection of extra portraits for various factions.

description:
This pretty much replaces every vanilla portrait in the game, excluding unique characters(for now)..

also, every male is now a variant of meowfficer, because i had too much fun thinking about what it would be like.

I hope you enjoy, and please let me know if any issues come up.

Update 02/10/22: Added 2 Luddic portraits, 5 Independent portraits. Replaced luddic_12, portrait43, portrait44, portrait45, and portrait 46.

Update 04/02/25 I: Separated all extra portraits into separate mini mod to make future updates a little easier.

Update 04/02/25 II: replaced all common meowficers to rare meowficers, added meowficer crew replacement mod that also replaces the pickup and drop sounds

Update 04/04/25: Accidentally uploaded and linked the un-updated version previously, reuploaded and linked the updated version.

aiDescription: Replaces nearly all vanilla portraits in the game with Azur Lane-style character designs. Adds a wide variety of extra portraits for different factions, including independent, pirate, and league characters. Includes a separate crew replacement mod that changes male crew to meowficer variants and updates their sound effects.
